name: Start · stop · gå
instruction: Start roligt; brems 3,2–4 s; stå stille 4–6 s; gå videre fra 6 s.
notes: Planar physical trial, not a finished duck animation.
Retarget joint positions to the final rig before use.
Head orientation is not physically simulated.
Passing six-second pose trials does not prove naturalness or long-term balance.
